## History

Adam was a pet rooster raised from a small yellow chick by [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md), who had originally received him from Mrs. Johnson at [Maywater](../codex/places.md#maywater). When [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) mentioned that [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) was preparing a rooster for dinner, [Faith](../character/faith.md) raced home in a panic to save him.
